title: InvestmentPlan
description: Investment plan schema for automatic DCA / scheduled investments. Supports daily, weekly, biweekly, monthly, and one-off schedules with confirmation rules and fee policy. All demo data must be synthetic.

plan_id.description: Unique identifier for this investment plan

day_of_week.description: For weekly/biweekly: which day of the week

day_of_month.description: For monthly: day of month (1-31). If day exceeds month length, last business day is used.

start_date.description: When this plan starts (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to plan creation date if omitted.

end_date.description: When this plan ends (YYYY-MM-DD). Null means ongoing.

assume_auto_execution.description: If true, scheduled transactions are treated as rule_confirmed when confirmation rules are met. If false, they remain pending_confirmation.

settlement_days.description: T+N days after scheduled date for NAV availability (default T+1)

qdii_lag_days.description: Additional lag days for QDII funds (applied on top of settlement_days)

require_nav_available.description: NAV must be available before rule confirmation

require_no_contradictory_evidence.description: No contradictory evidence (e.g. cancellation, refund) before rule confirmation

expected_confirmation_date_offset_days.description: Maximum days after scheduled date to wait for confirmation. Beyond this, remains pending.

cutoff_time.description: Daily cutoff time for same-day execution (HH:MM, 24h). Defaults to 15:00 (market close).

skip_non_trading_days.description: If true, non-trading days are skipped to next trading day

next_trading_day_on_skip.description: If a scheduled day is non-trading, execute on next trading day instead of skipping entirely

subscription_fee_rate.description: Subscription fee rate as decimal (e.g. 0.0015 = 0.15%). Null means unknown.

redemption_fee_rate.description: Redemption fee rate as decimal. Null means unknown.

fee_source.description: Source of the fee rate information

fee_discount_rate.description: Discount rate applied to subscription fee (e.g. 0.1 = 10% of stated fee). Common for Alipay platform discounts.

is_qdii.description: Whether this fund is a QDII fund (affects settlement timing)
